key_path: Sign up at sentry.io/signup (Google/GitHub OAuth or email+password; reCAPTCHA on the page; 14-day Business trial, no card)
Create org + first project (wizard or UI); org slug is needed for scoped MCP URLs
Credential: Settings > Developer Settings > Organization Tokens > create (shown once), OR Personal token, OR Internal Integration token for full API scope

Agent shortcut: `npx @sentry/wizard` or the new `sentry` CLI (`curl https://cli.sentry.dev/install | bash`, then `sentry auth`), which opens the browser and stores the token; legacy `sentry-cli login` only links to the token page for copy-paste

agent_native_auth.cli_browser_or_device_login: yes: new `sentry auth` CLI opens browser ('Opening browser for authentication'); wizard does browser login. Legacy sentry-cli login is a copy/paste flow
agent_native_auth.oauth_dcr_for_mcp: yes: mcp.sentry.dev says 'All connections use OAuth'; clients connect with no pre-registered client id
agent_native_auth.provisioning_api_mints_keys: partial: internal integrations/projects/DSN keys can be created via API once you hold a token; no anonymous provisioning
agent_native_auth.scoped_keys: yes: org tokens (fixed CI scopes), personal tokens with custom scopes, internal-integration tokens with editable scopes; MCP URL can be scoped to /{org}/{project}
agent_native_auth.test_dev_instances: no separate test mode (create extra projects instead)
agent_native_auth.free_tier: yes: free Developer plan, plus a 14-day Business trial with no card

mcp.local: npx @sentry/mcp-server (stdio, uses an access token); not re-verified this session
mcp.docs_mcp: docs-search tools are built into the product MCP
mcp.one_click: Cursor 'Install MCP Server' button; `npx @sentry/agent-plugin install` sets up skills plus the MCP for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Grok in one command

docs_for_agents.llms_txt: https://docs.sentry.io/llms.txt (contains explicit instructions for agents: install the plugin, don't rely on training data)
docs_for_agents.md_pages: yes, append .md to any docs URL
docs_for_agents.agent_skills: https://skills.sentry.dev/instrument; sentry-for-ai repo; dotagents package manager

score_justification: OAuth-only remote MCP, an agent plugin that installs everything with one command, and an llms.txt that tells agents what to do. A human still has to sign up and click through the browser.
best_practice: llms.txt starts with imperative instructions for agents ('do not rely on training data, run npx @sentry/agent-plugin install'); the MCP can be scoped to an org/project by URL path
biggest_gap: No anonymous or claimable path. Three token types confuse agents, and docs.sentry.io/ai/mcp returns 404 (MCP docs live on a separate domain)
notes: The legacy sentry-cli docs now point to a new interactive CLI at cli.sentry.dev, so the two CLIs are in transition.
